pages.title: Apply to Become a Tree Planting Agent
pages.description: Interested youth (18-35) participants should apply to become tree planting agents. You need to be living or working in the K2C Biosphere, preferably unemployed with experience in planting trees. Candidates will be approved using the geolocation (where you are based) and motivation on why you'd like to be part of the programme.
